verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own dbt Cloud integration lets users create and run dbt transformations immediately after syncs in Airbyte Cloud. That ties transformations to the completed load rather than to an independent timer. missing for 10: evidence for self-hosted/OSS or dbt Core support (documented only for Airbyte Cloud with dbt Cloud), detail on failure handling and job configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, dbt transformations run against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline, not on a blind timer

citations.quote: By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.
